descriptionChirho: Describing something as whole, complete, entire, or perfect — whether morally (a whole/undivided heart), physically (whole/uncut stones), or qualitatively (a full/complete weight or measure).
Describing a person who has returned or arrived safely, without harm — in a state of personal well-being and security.
Describing persons who are peaceably disposed, friendly, or well-intentioned toward others — not hostile.
